m: कार्दम mf(ई)n. (fr. कर्दम), made of mud, muddy, filled or covered with mud, R. v, 27, 16; Pāṇ. iv, 2, 2, Kāś.
belonging to Prajāpati Kardama, BhP. iii, 24, 6.
a: कार्दम — (मी f.), कार्दम(मि)क a. (की f.) [कर्दम-अण्-ठक् वा] Muddy, soiled or covered with mud.

m: कार्दमि m. a son of Kardama (see इड), R. vii, 87, 29.
कार्दमिक mf(ई, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 2, Vārtt.)n. muddy, Daś.
